P.text: A withdrawal is cancelled while still pending processing on L1, before processL1Withdrawals is called; the L2 withdrawal request is deleted but the corresponding L1 undelegate operation remains queued.
P.evidence_quote: If this withdrawal is later cancelled BEFORE calling processL1Withdrawals, the withdrawal request is deleted on L2(StakingManager), but the corresponding L1 operation to undelegate to staker remains in the queue.

I.text: Cancelling a withdrawal should prevent its corresponding L1 undelegate operation from being executed, keeping L2 and L1 state synchronized.
I.evidence_quote: This can lead to a desynchronization between L2 state and L1 states.

V.text: The cancelled withdrawal's L1 operation is still executed, and a user can queue a second withdrawal with the returned kHYPE, resulting in 2 ETH withdrawn when only 1 ETH was staked.
V.evidence_quote: Result: 2 ETH withdrawn from validator when only 1 ETH was staked creating an accounting inconsistency.
